metadata.description: Motorcortex AI tools — skills and MCP servers for AI assistants working with the Motorcortex motion control platform

plugins.name: mcx-core
plugins.description: Motorcortex platform context and live parameter access — terminology, how a Motorcortex system is put together, and skills to explore and write the parameter tree of a connected controller. Needs uv.

plugins.name: mcx-desk
plugins.description: Drive a running Motorcortex Desk tab — plot live controller signals and custom computed signals, control the view, capture screenshots, export CSV, analyze buffered samples. Requires Motorcortex Desk open in a browser and Node.js 18 or newer.
